purpose: Teach: ニッチ/日本航空/アリーナ/ソフィア/釜山/ジャマイカ/ユニセフ/松竹

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニッチなビジネスのお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he'll tell you about his interesting business venture.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone—like she's sharing something special. Soft opening, a slight smile underneath. Unhurried, inviting Sho to feel included in what Dad wants to share.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと日本航空のラウンジ行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the Japan Airlines lounge with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick breath in at the start. Words tumbling out—he can barely contain the thrill of something grown-up and new. Leaning forward slightly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアリーナのコンサートチケットを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father got you tickets to a concert at the arena.
lines.style: Gentle, pleased observation. Slight warmth in the middle—noticing how much this matters. Even pace, like she's savoring the moment of telling him. Tender trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとソフィアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a Sofia picture book together!
lines.style: Bright, uncomplicated joy. Words crisp and clear. Quick energy, like he wants to make sure she knows every detail. A child's pure happiness without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが釜山出張のお土産を下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought back a souvenir from his trip to Busan.
lines.style: Soft appreciation in the tone. Slight pause before speaking—she's noticing the pattern. Thoughtful, not rushed. A hint of something deeper underneath—she sees what he's doing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジャマイカ料理屋さん行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to a Jamaican restaurant!
lines.style: Unbridled enthusiasm. Words sharp and present. He's moving in his seat slightly—can't hold still with the excitement. The kind of innocent joy that needs to be heard fully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがユニセフへの募金を続けてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father continues to give to UNICEF, you know.
lines.style: Quiet reverence underneath the words. Slower pace. Not stating fact—reflecting on something she's come to understand about him. Composed but clearly moved.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと松竹の映画祭行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to the Shochiku film festival together!
lines.style: Pure, uncontained delight reaching a peak. Words tumbling with final energy. His voice bright and secure—he wants her to know this was special. A full, satisfied brightness closing out.
